basic_profile.bio: I'm a statistics major currently studying at UCLA. I'm interested in data analysis and computational methods, hoping to bridge the gap between statistics and computer science. I'm usually online during late evenings, especially after study sessions, and I enjoy browsing forums for academic advice. I work part-time as a tutor for high school students, helping them with math and statistics. I'm single and reside in Los Angeles, where I enjoy the diverse food scene and the occasional hike.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in statistics from my undergraduate studies and am currently exploring computing specializations to enhance my analytical skills. Most of my knowledge is academically oriented, but I seek practical insights through online forums and discussions.
